buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to

staff. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of CWE NO.02 Secunderabad A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. GENERAL 1.1 The works under the contract shall be carried out in accordance with conditionsspecified here in after. 2. AREA COVERAGE 2.1 Work/services are to be carried out under jurisdiction of GE Belgaum. 3. WORK FORCE 3.1 The requirement of JE(Civ), JE (E/M) & JE(QS&C) to be deployed per day is given as under :-

(a) JE (QS&C) - 01 Nos (b) JE (Civ) - 02 Nos (c ) JE (E/M) - 01 Nos 3.2 In support of employment of workmen, the attendance register shall be maintained by the contractor/ service provider, for verification byEngineer-in-charge. 4. JOB DESCRIPTION 4.01 JE(Civ) (a) The outsourced JE(Civ) will assist the department JE(Civ)/AGE(B/R) in all their duti es for carrying out supervision of all B/R works, preparation of DCS, maintaining Budget Ac counting, preparation of replies to audit objections, STE observations etc. efficiently and in the best interest of State as well as to enhance user satisfaction. (b) Assist AGE(B/R) in Site surveys, preparation of Preliminary Estimates, Designs, D rawings, Detailed estimates, BOQ etc. (c) Perform all duties as given in Table M part A to C of RMES excluding recording of measurement in MB, issue of Schedule B stores, making entries in Site Order Book, Test re gisters, Stage passing registers. (d) No independent charge shall be given to the outsourced JE(Civ). 4.02 JE(E/M) (a) The outsourced JE(E/M) will assist the department JE(E/M)/AGE(E/M) in all their du ties for carrying out supervision of all E/M works, preparation of DCS, maintaining Budget A ccounting, preparation of replies to audit objections, STE observations etc. efficiently and i n the best interest of State as well as to enhance user satisfaction. (b) Assist AGE(E/M) in Site surveys, preparation of Preliminary Estimates, Designs, D rawings, Detailed estimates, BOQ etc. (c) Perform all duties as given in Table M part A to C of RMES excluding recording of measurement in MB, issue of Schedule B stores, making entries in Site Order Book, Test re gisters, Stage passing registers. (d) No independent charge shall be given to the outsourced JE(E/M). 4.03 JE(QS&C) (a) The outsourced JE(QS&C) will assist the department JE(QS&C) /AGE(Contracts) /A CWE(Contracts) /DCWE(Contracts) in all their duties for carrying out estimation, quantity s urveying, preparation of Tender, Scrutiny of RAR/Final Bill, compiling of Reports and Return s, Day to day correspondence, Market enquiry and preparation of Rate analysis, preparatio n of original Contract Agreement and CTC, Preparation of replies to audit objections, STE o bservations etc efficiently and in the best interest of State. (b) Perform all duties as given in Table N of RMES.

(c) No independent charge shall be given to the outsourced JE(QS&C). 5. QUALIFICATION OF JEs 5.1 JE(Civ) should have a degree in CivilEngineering(B Tech) from a recognized university/ins titute with minimum 3 years work experience or a diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institute with minimum 5 years work experience. The work experience should be in the r elated field to include planning, supervision and execution of B/R works in civil projects in any repu ted construction company. 5.2 JE(E/M) should have a degree in Electrical Engineering(B Tech) from a recognized universi ty/institute with minimum 3 years work experience or a diploma in Electrical Engineering from a re cognized university/institute with minimum 5 years work experience. The work experience should be in the related field to include planning, supervision and execution of electrical works in civil proj ects in any reputed construction company 5.3 JE(QS&C) should have a degree in Civil Engineering(B Tech) from a recognizeduniversity/i nstitute with minimum 3 years work experience or a diploma in Civil Engineering from a recognize d university/institute with minimum 5 years work experience. The work experience should be in th e related field to include planning and execution of contract related works in any reputed construct ion company. 5.4 The outsourced JEs should be Medically Fit so as to be able to perform all the assigned ta sks unhindered and in a suitable manner. No excuses on this account will be accepted after deploy ment. The Service provider shall provide a replacement in such cases immediately. To avoid such i nstances, the service provider will submit to the department a Medical Certificate of fitness for the task in respect of all JEs before deployment. 6 WORKING HOURS: 6.1. 0900 Hrs to 1730Hrs (Monday to Saturday). Holiday on Sundays. 7 PAYMENT CONDITIONS 7.1 GEBelgaum will be the Nodal authority and will be responsible for making running paym ents and FB in respect of all outsourced JEs under AOR of CWE No.2, Secunderabadunder this c ontract.

8. PERFORMANCE SECURITY. 8.1 Performance security in any forms of Bank guarantee in the prescribed form or Govern ment securities or FDR for an amount equivalent to 5% of the contract sum in favour of CWE N o.2 Secunderabad. Failure of the successful bidder to deliver the performance security within t he stipulated time shall constitute sufficient grounds for cancellation of theaward of work.. 8.2 Performance security should remain valid for a period of Sixty days beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations by the contractor. In case of cancellation of contract du e to violation by the contractor of any of the terms and conditions laid herein above or in SLA/GT C/ATC, the performance security deposited by the contractor shall be forfeited along with levyin g of other penalties/cancellation charges specified elsewhere in the contract documents. 9. PARTICULAR SPECIFICATION 9.1 The approved outsourcing of above service for the category may be reduced proportiona tely on posting in / promotion of concerned category during the contract period. .
